other_conditions: Must be a student studying in middle school, high school, or college
Must actively participate in state or national‑level sports competitions
Athletes achieving national‑level recognition are eligible
benefits_summary: Provides annual scholarships of ₹2,500 for middle/high‑school students and ₹3,000 for college athletes, plus ₹10,000 incentives for national/international recognition and sports materials.
